#!/usr/bin/bash
# Private isolated ARM64 VM diagnostic. Never a phone script.
set -euo pipefail
read -r cmdline < /proc/cmdline
[[ $$ == 1 && $EUID == 0 && " $cmdline " == *' rog5.icon_fixture=1 '* && -d /sys/bus/virtio/devices ]]
trap 'echo "FAIL icon PID1 setup line=$LINENO"; /usr/bin/poweroff -ff' ERR
export PATH=/usr/bin LANG=C.UTF-8
cp -a /etc /run/fixture-etc
mount --bind /run/fixture-etc /etc
source /run/logind-linker-cache.sh
prepare_linker_cache
mount -t tmpfs -o mode=0755,size=32m tmpfs /var
mkdir -p /var/lib /var/log /var/tmp /etc/systemd/system
chmod 1777 /var/tmp
printf '47b22e3177df4db18d6ed283dff17712\n' > /etc/machine-id
printf 'rog5-icons-vm\n' > /etc/hostname
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rog5-icons.target <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Isolated icon cache diagnostic
DefaultDependencies=no
Requires=rog5-icons.service
After=rog5-icons.service
EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rog5-icons.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Unprivileged GTK icon lookup
DefaultDependencies=no
OnFailure=poweroff.target
OnSuccess=poweroff.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=1000
Group=1000
ExecStart=/usr/bin/bash /run/lookup.sh
TimeoutStartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=10
KillMode=control-group
StandardOutput=tty
StandardError=inherit
TTYPath=/dev/console
EOF
mkdir -p /run/gtk-runtime
source /run/logind-icon-cache.sh
stage_icon_cache
echo 'OBSERVE icon diagnostic exec packaged systemd PID1; no login or Denial'
exec /usr/lib/systemd/systemd --unit=rog5-icons.target --log-target=console --log-level=info
